name: HRP-3 Promet Mk-II
maker: AIST / Kawada Industries / Kawasaki Heavy Industries
summary: A dust- and splash-proof (IP52) member of Japan's HRP line, built by AIST with Kawada and Kawasaki so a humanoid could work outdoors in rain and dust — it was demonstrated operating under a 100 mm/h shower and doing bridge-construction bolt work.
notable: Demonstrated working in simulated heavy rain
